CONTACT SUMMARY & SESSION OVERVIEW
- Session Stage: Weekly Follow-Up (~15 min, phone)
- Summary: CM and [Client] reconnected after missed calls on both sides. CM followed up on the Welvista application; [Client] believes he was not accepted and never heard back. CM completed and submitted a Medicaid application with [Client] by phone. [Client] already receives SNAP/EBT. He reports being behind on housing payments and having no current income, and asked for help finding work.

CASE PLAN ALIGNMENT
- Stability Tier: At Risk
- Stated Goals Progress: Healthcare coverage – Medicaid application submitted 11/16/2026; Welvista outcome unclear (no contact received). Employment – [Client] asked for job leads in Clarendon County [confirm county]; open to any type of work. Resume not yet created.

BRIEFCASE & GATES 1-4 UPDATES
- Gate 1 (Vital IDs, Meds, Supervision): No health coverage. Welvista application previously submitted; [Client] reports no response and believes he was not accepted. Medicaid application submitted this session (no prior Medicaid, no unpaid medical bills).
- Gate 2 (Housing, Comms, Legal, Resume): Living in transitional housing; reports being behind on payments (approx. $800 [confirm]). Old email on file is no longer used and the Medicaid system would not allow an update; CM added a note to the application with [Client]'s current phone number. [Client] has given an updated email and a second phone number (803-225-XXXX, incomplete); update contact info in Apricot. No resume yet.
- Gate 3 (Health, Recovery, Banking): Has one bank account (opened through a past job) that he does not use; account details and balance unknown. Medicaid pending.
- Gate 4 (Work Gear, Transit, Employment/Finance): No income currently; no employment in the past year. No vehicle or other property. Receives SNAP/EBT. Open to any type of work.

EMPLOYMENT, HOUSING & STABILITY UPDATES
- Unemployed; requested job referrals in Clarendon County [confirm]. Living in transitional housing and behind on payments. Declined voter registration.

REFERRALS & RESOURCE COORDINATION
- SC Medicaid – application submitted 11/16/2026.
- Welvista – follow-up; outcome unclear.
- Employment leads – CM to send job leads in [Client]'s requested county.

NEXT STEPS ("WHAT TO WORK ON NEXT")
1. [Client] to let CM know if he hears from Medicaid or Welvista.
2. CM to send job leads and call [Client] on 11/17 to build a Turn90 resume (~5 min); check Medicaid status if [Client] hasn't been contacted.
3. Apricot Admin Check: Update [Client]'s email and phone number in Bio Info; confirm the second phone number.

sessions.notes_text:
### Contact Summary
Reentry Navigator Daisy Boynton met with client Dwayne Robinson (Apricot ID: 22888) to complete his Welvista and SNAP applications. Dwayne reported he is currently living in a transitional house in Manning, SC, but is $600-$700 behind on rent. His phone is currently disconnected but he expects to have it turned on in the next few days. 

### Case Plan Goal Progress
- **Welvista & SNAP Applications:** Dwayne reported he already completed and mailed his SNAP application yesterday. Daisy proceeded to complete the Welvista application over the phone with him to secure his mental health medications. 
- **Find Work / Income:** Dwayne stated he has no monthly income and his rent is $800, leading to arrears. Finding sustainable work remains a high priority.

### Briefcase & Gate 1-4 Updates
- **State ID:** Identified as a barrier. While Dwayne has an ID, it lists an old Charleston address. Needs to be updated to his current Manning, SC address.
- **Reliable Phone:** Identified as a barrier. Phone service is currently inactive.
- **Welvista Medications:** Application submitted by Navigator during this session; waiting on processing.

### Referrals/Resources Provided
- Welvista Prescription Assistance (Application submitted during session).
- Offer to assist with filling out voter registration paperwork (Dwayne has the paper but requested help completing it).

### Next Steps
- Dwayne to text pictures of his ID and probation paperwork to Daisy so she can submit them with the Welvista application.
- Dwayne to call Daisy once his phone is turned back on (expected in 2-3 days).
- Daisy to assist Dwayne with updating his State ID to his current address and filling out his voter registration card.
